The '''''Atrivis Day 2''''' was a [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|BFF-1 bulk freighter]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] to ferry supplies. It was part of the freighter group [[Atrivis Day group|''Atrivis Day'']]. It was part of a convoy traveling to the [[Organarms]] [[Deep Space Manufacturing Facility]] that [[Battle of Organarms|encountered]] an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Missile Boat]]. Its presence in this engagement was later replayed in an Imperial [[Flight simulator/Legends|holosimulator]] mission, training pilots for the Missile Boat.

==Description==
''Atrivis Day 2'' was the name of a [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|BFF-1 bulk freighter]] working for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the early years of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Working in conjunction with ''[[Atrivis Day 1]]'', ''[[Atrivis Day 3|3]]'' and ''[[Atrivis Day 4|4]]'', the four freighters were collectively known as [[Atrivis Day group|''Atrivis Day'']]. The freighter was metallic gray, with some red inner panel. It was equipped with [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] and a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]].<ref name="DOE" />

==History==
===Rebel service===
At the start of the [[Zaarin insurrection]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], ''Atrivis Day 2'' was part of an Alliance convoy hauling supplies to the [[Organarms]] [[Deep Space Manufacturing Facility]]. In addition to the ''Atrivis Day'' group, the convoy was composed of the [[Container transport|Container Transport]] group [[Kempman group|''Kempman'']], the [[Modular conveyor|Modular Conveyor]] group [[Altar Moon group|''Altar Moon'']], the freighter group [[Rimrunner group|''Rimrunner'']] and eight other container [[Starship/Legends|ships]]. Military support was provided by the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|Nebulon-B escort frigate]] ''[[Dahome]]'' as well as fighters from [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red]], [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Gold]], and [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Blue Squadrons]].<ref name="DOE" />

''Atrivis Day 2'' was part of a group of freighters at the forefront of the convoy, hauling raw materials. However, upon reverting from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], it found the Organarms facility destroyed, the target of a lone [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Missile Boat]], still in-system. This enemy craft was joined shortly after by the Imperial [[Strike-class medium cruiser|''Strike''-class medium cruiser]] ''[[Arjun]]''. As the small Imperial craft moved to [[Battle of Organarms|engage]] ''Atrivis Day 2'' and its companion freighters, the rest of the convoy began to arrive in-system, beginning with a number of [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighters]] and [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]] from Red Squadron, who moved to attack the Imperial forces.<ref name="DOE" />

===Legacy===
The role of the ''Atrivis Day 2'' at this battle was later included in an Imperial [[Flight simulator/Legends|simulation]] used to train [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] for the Missile Boat. Such notable pilots as [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]],<ref name="DOE" /> an eventual [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]],<ref name="The Emperor's Pawns">{{GamerCite|5|The Emperor's Pawns}}</ref> trained on this mission.<ref name="DOE" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Atrivis Day 2'' was created for [[LucasArts]]' [[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter - Defender of the Empire'']] ([[1994]]), the expansion pack to their [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']]. There, it appeared as an enemy vessel in the first simulator mission, training the player in the use of the Missile Boat. These simulator missions were based on in-universe historical missions. Consequently, the actual existence of the ''Atrivis Day 1'' in [[canon]] is confirmed, but the specific outcome of the original engagement is not. Instead, the simulation allows the player to accomplish the mission to varying degrees of completeness. As the destruction of the ''Atrivis Day'' group is only a secondary goal for the player,<ref name="TIE Fighter: Defender of the Empire: Official Secrets & Solutions">''[[TIE Fighter: Defender of the Empire: Official Secrets & Solutions]]''</ref> the mission can be accomplished with or without their destruction, leaving uncertainty as to the ship's final in-universe fate.

The name of this freighter is likely a nod to the [[Atrivis sector/Legends|Atrivis sector]], a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] known to be an early hotbed of Rebel activity.<ref name="The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook">''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]''</ref>
